basic_details.short_information: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released a notification dated 31 October 2026 for 187 Group-C technical vacancies under the Residual Parent Cadre (RPC). The recruitment includes 105 Assistant Town Planner, 80 Junior Engineer (Civil) and 2 Draftsman posts across Karnataka Government departments, authorities, boards and corporations. Candidates with a Diploma in Civil Engineering or other prescribed equivalent qualifications can apply, depending on the post. The pay scale is Rs. 54,175 to Rs. 99,400. Online applications started on 31 October 2

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification specifies separate deadlines for submitting the online application and paying the examination fee. Candidates must complete the application by 26 November and the applicable fee payment by 27 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: KEA has announced 187 Group-C technical posts under the RPC recruitment notification. These include Assistant Town Planner, Junior Engineer (Civil) and Draftsman vacancies. Note: The notification states that the advertised vacancies are provisional and may change according to the requirements and instructions of the respective recruiting departments.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Examinations Authority has issued an 18-page Kannada notification dated 31 October 2026 for 187 RPC Group-C technical vacancies in various Karnataka Government departments and organizations. The notification includes post-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limits, salary, fees, examination pattern, reservation provisions and application instructions. Official Recruitment Website: KEA Recruitment Notifications

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering or another specifically accepted qualification , depending on the post. The notification includes separate educational criteria for Assistant Town Planner, Junior Engineer and Draftsman positions. Important: For Greater Bengaluru Authority Junior Engineer posts, preference will be given to candidates trained in AutoCAD. Candidates must meet the specific qualification requirements of the post and recruiting organization they select. The notification requires candidates to possess the prescribed educational qualification by the application closing date. Candidates whose qualifications are not officially recognized or are not accepted as equivalent may be disqualified during verification. Applicants must provide the relevant diploma certificates and marksheets when requested. Holding a qualification other than the prescribed qualification does not automatically establish eligibility.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years . The maximum age depends on the candidate's reservation category and the applicable Karnataka Government age-relaxation provisions. The notification incorporates an additional five-year general age concession under the applicable Karnataka Government order. The limits shown above reflect the resulting category-wise upper ages.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notified pay scale for Assistant Town Planner, Junior Engineer (Civil) and Draftsman posts is Rs. 54,175 to Rs. 99,400 . The notification provides the pay progression as Rs. 54,175-1,375-58,300-1,500-64,300-1,650-74,200-1,900-85,600-2,300-99,400 . These figures represent the basic pay scale, not a fixed in-hand monthly salary. Applicable allowances and deductions will be governed by Karnataka Government rules.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee varies according to the candidate's category. Fee Payment Last Date: 27 November 2026. Payment Mode: Online through the payment facility provided by KEA. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicants should confirm their category and applicable fee before making payment.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the competitive examination conducted by KEA , the compulsory Kannada language examination wherever applicable, and verification of eligibility and documents. Online Application: Candidates submit their applications through the KEA recruitment portal. Competitive Examination: KEA will conduct the prescribed objective examination for the notified technical posts. Compulsory Kannada Language Examination: Candidates who are not exempt under the notified rules must qualify in the Kannada language examination. Document Verification: KEA or the concerned department will verify educational qualifications, age, reservation and other eligibility certificates. Final Selection: Selection will be subject to examination performance, applicable reservation rules and verification of eligibility.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The competitive examination will consist of two papers, each carrying 100 marks . The examination will be conducted in offline OMR format. Paper 1 covers subjects including current affairs, everyday science, geography, Indian Constitution, Indian history, Karnataka history, Karnataka administration, rural development, Panchayat Raj institutions and other general knowledge topics. Paper 2 will assess technical knowledge relevant to the prescribed educational qualifications and the selected post. Candidates should follow the detailed syllabus and further examination instructions issued by KEA. The notification prescribes a deduction of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer in the competitive examination.

content_sections.heading: KEA Compulsory Kannada Language Test 2027
content_sections.text: The notification schedules the compulsory Kannada language examination for 8 January 2027, from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM . Eligible candidates who have already qualified in a recognized compulsory Kannada examination or meet the prescribed Kannada-medium educational criteria may be exempt, subject to the notification's conditions. The Kannada language test is qualifying and its marks are not added to competitive examination merit.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for the 187 RPC Group-C technical posts through the official KEA website from 31 October to 26 November 2026. Apply Online: KEA Recruitment 2026 Official Portal Online Application Last Date: 26 November 2026. Application Fee Payment Last Date: 27 November 2026. Candidates must select the relevant RPC recruitment notification and follow the instructions provided on the KEA recruitment portal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates should follow the exact instructions displayed on the official KEA portal. Incorrect qualifications, category details or unsupported reservation claims may result in rejection.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the relevant educational and other certificates supporting their application details. The official notification also contains specific instructions regarding reservation certificates and document verification. SSLC or equivalent certificate for date-of-birth verification. Relevant Civil Engineering or other prescribed diploma certificate. Diploma marksheets. Reservation or caste certificate, if applicable. Rural reservation certificate, if claiming the applicable benefit. Kannada-medium study certificate, if applicable. Ex-Serviceman certificate, if applicable. PwD certificate, where applicable. Transgender identity certificate, where applicable. Other supporting certificates specified in the notification. Recent passport-size photograph. Candidate signature. Candidates must ensure that uploaded images are clear and comply with the prescribed specifications.

faq.question: Q1. Which post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Assistant Town Planner has the most, with 105 of the 187 posts. Among Junior Engineer (Civil) posts, the Greater Bengaluru Authority has the largest share with 46.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I am waiting for my final diploma result?
faq.answer: No. You must hold the prescribed qualification and certificate on 26 November 2026, and candidates awaiting results are not eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Can I pay the fee after the application closes?
faq.answer: Yes, by one day. Applications close on 26 November 2026, while the fee can be paid online until 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need AUTOCAD training for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: It is not mandatory, but the Greater Bengaluru Authority gives preference to candidates trained in AUTOCAD. The notice prints no such preference for the other organisations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualifying mark in the competitive examination?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least 35% marks to qualify, and merit is prepared from those who reach it. In the Kannada Language Test, the qualifying score is 50 out of 150 unless the candidate is exempt.

faq.question: Q6. Will I lose marks for leaving a question blank?
faq.answer: Yes, if you do not shade the 5th option on the OMR sheet. An unshaded question costs 0.25 mark, the same as a wrong answer.

faq.question: Q7. Can I correct a mistake after submitting the application?
faq.answer: No, nothing can be edited once the application is submitted. The one exception is a wrongly claimed reservation, which can be deleted from the Candidate Verification Slip before mock allotment begins.

faq.question: Q8. Can I be selected under both KEA notifications?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can get only one post across this notice and notification No. ED/KEA/40/Ne.Vi/2026 (KK), decided by the options entered, eligibility, reservation and merit.

faq.question: Q9. Which ID should I carry to the examination?
faq.answer: Carry one original ID from the accepted list, such as a PAN card, Aadhaar card, passport or voter ID, along with your admit card.

faq.question: Q10. Does the National Pension System apply to every post?
faq.answer: No. It does not apply to the 12 Junior Engineer (Civil) posts at Karnataka Rural Infrastructure Development Limited, but it applies to the other organisations listed.
